advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? En... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway, it has multiple meanings~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-covered town, an aged warrior is about to face his final hour, and his glorious old body is about to begin a new chapter.
advancements.doctor_m.obtain_time_key.de: We have the ability to do anything we want. Absolute control over every particle in the universe. Absolute control over everything that has ever existed and everything that will ever exist. From now on, are you listening to me, Romana? Because if you aren't, I can make you listen, because I can do anything. From this moment on, there is no free will in the entire universe. Only my will, because I possess the Key of Time!
message.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.li: No Time Lord president other than Rassilon has ever obtained the Key of Rassilon...
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line: Destroy this gun, destroy all its data, and do not let its immense power corrupt your mind...
message.doctor_m.time_key_resurrection: §bOwner of the Time Key, your power does not end here. You will not be troubled by the trivial matter of death. The Six-Fold God still watches over you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.tip: A crystal that may have countless origins*Rassilon possessed it, or perhaps its maker*Now that you have obtained it, the universe shall bow to you.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.tip: A golden pocket watch...*It holds a portion of the Time Key's power*Can reverse the death of its wearer...
message.doctor_m.time_key.neutral_tip: §7Sneak + right-click to enable forced neutral mode
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.revived: §dThe authority of the Time Key fragment prevented death from occurring..
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.cooldown: §cThe pocket watch cannot protect you forever; you must wait for its recovery. Remaining time: %s
